sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Saudi Arabia), Visa platform (منصة التأشيرات), front page

blockers.sought: The permit a foreign performer needs to be engaged in Saudi Arabia (the General Entertainment Authority's licensing, the work visa, or an event visa)

tried.institution: gea.gov.sa answers 'Access Unavailable' (403) to this client; enter.sa loads by script; visa.mofa.gov.sa's platform (saved) serves a log-in page with no category list; hrsd.gov.sa answers but its service pages weren't located; mol.gov.sa doesn't answer (2026-11-01). Retry 2026-11-01: gea.gov.sa and my.gov.sa answer 403; laws.boe.gov.sa and boe.gov.sa (the Bureau of Experts' legislation) reset the connection; qiwa.sa serves a 246-byte script shell; hrsd.gov.sa and visa.mofa.gov.sa answer but carry no performer or work-visa category readable without log-in; enter.sa now belongs to a telecom company. First pass: gea.gov.sa 403, visa platform log-in only, mol.gov.sa no answer.
tried.official-register: No regulation text on foreign performers' licensing reached (the GEA's regulations pages are behind the same 403). Retry 2026-11-01: the Bureau of Experts' legislation database (laws.boe.gov.sa) resets the connection, so the Labour Law's foreign-worker articles and the GEA's licensing regulations weren't read.
tried.web-search: The session's shared web-search budget was used up on 2026-11-01 before this country; no search could be run. 'Saudi Arabia work visa foreign artist performer entertainment visa General Entertainment Authority' (2026-11-01): Wikipedia, setupinsaudi, Gulf News (event-visa counts, GEA 22% of event visas in 2023), a contract-template site; no primary naming the procedure, fee, time or term. Further searches couldn't run (the session's budget ran out).
tried.trade-press: Layer 3 found Arabian Business refusing (403) and Al Tamimi answering 406; not retried after the search budget ran out. Gulf News (2023 event-visa figures) and Arabian Business (performer numbers) give no procedure; Al Tamimi answered 406 in layer 3.
tried.archive: web.archive.org resets the connection from this environment (2026-11-01). web.archive.org resets the connection from this environment (2026-11-01).
